# epistemic self-trust

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:epistemicSelfTrust`](gmeow-epistemicSelfTrust.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/epistemicSelfTrust>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/metacognition`](../../slices/metacognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reliability an agent accords to one of its OWN epistemic faculties or sources — feeling-of-knowing: how far the agent trusts its own memory, perception, or reasoning on a matter. The flat 80% surface (an agent trusts its own faculty / source); the RANGE is left open (the trusted faculty, source, or own-state), documented in prose. NOT functional: an agent trusts different faculties to different degrees. A metacognitive form of trust, second-order because its object is the agent's own epistemic apparatus rather than an external trustee.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record an agent's reliance on its own epistemic faculty or source — feeling-of-knowing, the trust an agent places in its own memory, perception, or reasoning — the cheap surface a trustworthy memory reads when deciding how far to lean on a recalled belief.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for trust in an EXTERNAL agent or source (that is the trust slice's [`gmeow:TrustAssertion`](../classes/gmeow-TrustAssertion.md) directly), avoid re-minting trust machinery (reuse [`gmeow:trustLevel`](gmeow-trustLevel.md) by reference for the graded form), and avoid asserting an [rdfs:range](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#range); the trusted-faculty surface stays open.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:epistemicSelfTrust`](gmeow-epistemicSelfTrust.md) from the agent to its own faculty / source for the flat case; for the graded form, mint a [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) (vantage = the agent, [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) = the agent's own faculty) carrying [`gmeow:trustLevel`](gmeow-trustLevel.md) from the trust slice, rather than minting a new degree term.

### Scope notes

- Reuse the trust slice, do not re-mint it ([Principle 6](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-6)): the rich, graded form of self-trust is a [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) whose [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) is the agent and whose [`gmeow:observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) is the agent's own faculty / source, carrying [`gmeow:trustLevel`](gmeow-trustLevel.md) (trust slice) — self-trust is trust-about-oneself, the [`gmeow:trustor`](gmeow-trustor.md) and [`gmeow:trustee`](gmeow-trustee.md) coinciding. This property is the cheap surface; promote to the standpoint-claim idiom when the degree, scale, or vantage of self-trust is itself the fact. The bridge to the trust slice is documented routing, asserting no triples into it.
